errors.evidence: This description inaccurately portrays the trend for the harvested area (orange bars) as a simple downward trend starting from 2014. It misses the initial increase from approximately 30,000 hectares in 2014 to the peak of about 36,000 hectares in 2015, before the subsequent decrease began.
